$comment: Time-boxed accepted risk for scripts/audit-policy.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry; expired entries fail CI. Remove an entry as soon as the dependency is upgraded.

entries.reason: Zod 3 is used only for client-side form validation in apps/web; no z.array() schema exists in the codebase, and the advisory concerns oversized array validation. Server-side input is validated by class-validator. Upgrading to zod 4 is a separate major migration with no server-side risk reduced.

Vitest is a dev-only test runner and is not part of any runtime image. Exploitation requires control of the test files or config already running with developer privileges. Tracked for a Vitest 4 upgrade outside this remediation window.
Same Vitest 3 toolchain; dev-only, not shipped. See the vitest entry.
